briefing: Field Report from Agent Polaris: The Minnesota Department of Human Services is investigating allegations of fraud in child care centers, leading to a federal payment freeze and putting some families at risk of losing child care. The Justice Department has also dropped its criminal investigation into Federal Reserve Chair Jerome Powell. These investigations have the potential to uncover large-scale financial schemes and raise questions about the integrity of the investigations and the potential for future wrongdoing. Further investigation is needed to determine the extent of the fraud and who is responsible.
